thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 01/03/2019: IZEA, RESN, MSFT, AAPL, CSCO, GOOG, IBM

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 01/03/2019: IZEA, RESN, MSFT, AAPL, CSCO, GOOG, IBM
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -1.18%
AAPL: -8.88%
IBM: -0.51%
CSCO: -1.30%
GOOG: -0.78%
Technology stocks were sinking in Thursday's pre-bell trade.
Early movers include:
(+) IZEA Worldwide ( IZEA ), which was up 25% after announcing that it won multiple contracts last month. IZEA operates IZEAx, an online marketplace connecting brands and publishers with influential content creators.
(+) Resonant ( RESN ) was over 2% higher as it reported four new license agreements with its largest "Tier 1" filter customer.
(-) Apple ( AAPL ) was down more than 9% as the technology firm cut its revenue guidance for the fiscal first quarter late on Wednesday, blaming fewer iPhone upgrades than anticipated in some emerging markets. The company now expects sales of about $84.0 billion during the three months that ended December 30, well below the analyst consensus of $91.4 billion on Capital IQ.
